# `silk/platform/wasm/heap`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The linear-memory heap of every wasm32 module, and the report buffer of a module without WASI.

## When to use
The wasm32 entry modules export `malloc`, `free`, `calloc` and `realloc` from [`WasmHeap`](#WasmHeap), and
a module without host services exports its report through [`WasmHeap.report`](#WasmHeap.impl.report). Applications use
`Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider`.

## Details
The heap starts at the linker's `__heap_base` and grows with `memory.grow`. Its first bytes hold
the heap's own state, which a fresh linear memory already holds as zeros: the top chunk, the
lock, the report's length, the bin map, the bins and the report buffer. Chunks follow.

Each chunk is a 16-byte header and a payload aligned to 16. A header holds the size of the chunk
before it while that one is free, then the chunk's own size with two flags, so a release
coalesces a chunk with both neighbors. Free chunks wait in bins by size: one per 16 bytes below
1 KiB, then four per power of two. The last chunk is the top, which grows the memory instead of
joining a bin. Positions are byte offsets from the heap's start; offset zero, inside the
state, is no chunk. With the `multi` threading profile one lock serializes the heap.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.allocate"></a>

### Associated function `allocate`

```silk
pub unsafe fn allocate(size: usize) -> ?[*]mut u8
```

Returns uninitialized storage of at least `size` bytes aligned to 16, or null when the
memory cannot grow.

#### Safety
Release a non-null result once with [`WasmHeap.release`](#WasmHeap.impl.release) after every access ends.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.allocateZeroed"></a>

### Associated function `allocateZeroed`

```silk
pub unsafe fn allocateZeroed(count: usize, size: usize) -> ?[*]mut u8
```

Returns storage of `count * size` zero bytes, or null when the product overflows or the
memory cannot grow.

#### Safety
Release a non-null result once with [`WasmHeap.release`](#WasmHeap.impl.release) after every access ends.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.release"></a>

### Associated function `release`

```silk
pub unsafe fn release(allocation: ?[*]mut u8) -> ()
```

Releases storage from [`WasmHeap.allocate`](#WasmHeap.impl.allocate). Null does nothing.

#### Safety
`allocation` must be null or a live result of this heap, released once, after every access.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.resize"></a>

### Associated function `resize`

```silk
pub unsafe fn resize(allocation: ?[*]mut u8, size: usize) -> ?[*]mut u8
```

Keeps an allocation that already holds `size` bytes; otherwise moves its bytes to a new
one and releases the old. Returns null, keeping the old allocation, when the memory cannot
grow. A null `allocation` allocates.

#### Safety
`allocation` must be null or a live result of this heap. After a non-null result, only that
result may be used.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.reportWrite"></a>

### Associated function `reportWrite`

```silk
pub unsafe fn reportWrite(bytes: ?[*]const u8, length: usize) -> bool
```

Appends what fits of `bytes` to the report buffer, and answers whether all of it did.
Threads that report at once each reserve their own bytes.

#### Safety
`bytes` must address `length` readable bytes.

<a id="WasmHeap.impl.empty"></a>

### Associated function `empty`

```silk
pub fn empty() -> ?[*]mut u8
```

A non-null address aligned to 16 that holds no storage, for empty allocations that are
never read or released.
